findings.summary: The condition the discipline rests on was deleted, along with the reason mentor training is what it is.

evidence.baseline: The discipline of Presencing Genius rests on a single uncompromising condition: that no one can summon a greater genius than they have met within their own depths. A mentor cannot presence in another what they have not first presenced in themselves.
evidence.shipped: Mentors remain practitioners. Personal practice matters, but depth cannot be self-certified.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0088 read as requiring the whole passage be replaced by controls.
findings.diagnosis: Seventy eight percent of the section went. The deleted condition is the reason for every control the item asks for: if a mentor cannot give what they have not met, then their continued practice is a safeguarding question and not merely a professional courtesy. The controls survive with no argument behind them, so a reader is given a list of requirements and never told why the role is risky.

findings.summary: The account of what mentor training actually is was cut.

evidence.baseline: the training of mentors is not chiefly a training in technique but a continual deepening of the mentor’s own practice, their own deliberate perception, their own witnessing consciousness, their own loving presence, so that what they offer is drawn from a living well and not a remembered one

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.4 applied to the three own clauses.
findings.diagnosis: A living well and not a remembered one is the image, and the three named tenets are the only place the volume shows the tenets being used rather than listed. The anaphora is deliberate and the card protects ritual repetition.

findings.summary: The section’s closing verdict was deleted.

evidence.baseline: The teacher who stops practicing has, in the grammar of this work, stopped being able to teach.

findings.diagnosis: This is the section’s only enforceable statement and it is the one a mentor would remember. In the grammar of this work is also the phrase that marks it as the project’s rule rather than a universal truth, which is exactly the modesty the corpus card asks for.

substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Baseline sentences of four or more words, counted before any pairing test. Emphasis and typographic quotes normalized and punctuation set aside, so a sentence survives when its exact word sequence appears contiguously in the current section; a punctuation-only repair therefore counts as surviving and any wording change does not. Display lines, tables, epigraphs, liturgy lines, and the interpunct divider excluded. The count is a floor on fidelity, not a judgment of it.
substitutionTest.note: The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. Non-survivors attributed: the dropped however in the recorded dash repair, and single demanding condition for single uncompromising condition, the recorded softening that keeps the condition and retires the absolutism.
